item.title: CVE-2026-113697 · 4.8 MEDIUM — Reflected Cross-Site Scripting in BMC Helix Operations Management
item.description: Reflected cross-site scripting in the agent query feature of BMC Helix Operations Management 25.4.00 allows authenticated attackers to execute script in another user's browser after that user opens a crafted link.

item.title: CVE-2026-113696 · 5.3 MEDIUM — Improper Authorization in BMC ITSM SmartIT Change Approvals
item.description: Improper authorization in the SmartIT change approval feature of BMC IT Service Management Suite versions 25.3.01, 25.4.01, and 26.1.01 allows authenticated users to make unauthorized changes to approval state and bypass intended approval restriction…

item.title: CVE-2026-113695 · 4.8 MEDIUM — Reflected Cross-Site Scripting in BMC ITSM SmartIT
item.description: Reflected cross-site scripting in the SmartIT inline-image attachment feature of BMC IT Service Management Suite versions 25.3.01, 25.4.01, and 26.1.01 allows authenticated users to inject script content into HTML responses viewed by another user.

item.title: CVE-2026-113694 · 5.3 MEDIUM — Improper Authorization in BMC ITSM SmartIT Attachments
item.description: Improper authorization in the SmartIT user attachment feature of BMC IT Service Management Suite versions 25.3.01, 25.4.01, and 26.1.01 allows authenticated users to access or modify attachment resources belonging to other users.

item.title: CVE-2026-113693 · 5.3 MEDIUM — System Account Credential Disclosure in BMC ITSM
item.description: Exposure of sensitive information in the SmartIT system-account settings of BMC IT Service Management Suite versions 25.3.01, 25.4.01, and 26.1.01 allows authenticated users to retrieve a system username and encrypted password value.

item.title: CVE-2026-113692 · 6.9 MEDIUM — Path Traversal in BMC ITSM
item.description: Path traversal in the SmartIT file-management feature of BMC IT Service Management Suite versions 25.3.01, 25.4.01, and 26.1.01 allows authenticated administrators to read files outside the intended directory.

item.title: CVE-2026-113691 · 5.1 MEDIUM — Stored Cross-Site Scripting in BMC ITSM Knowledge Articles
item.description: Stored cross-site scripting in the SmartIT knowledge-article feature of BMC IT Service Management Suite versions 25.3.01, 25.4.01, and 26.1.01 allows authenticated users to execute stored scripts in other users' browsers.

item.title: CVE-2026-113690 · 4.8 MEDIUM — Stored Cross-Site Scripting in BMC ITSM Attachments
item.description: Stored cross-site scripting in the SmartIT attachment feature of BMC IT Service Management Suite versions 25.3.01, 25.4.01, and 26.1.01 allows authenticated users to execute uploaded script content in other users' browsers.

item.title: CVE-2026-113689 · 5.1 MEDIUM — Stored Cross-Site Scripting in BMC ITSM Work Notes
item.description: Stored cross-site scripting in the SmartIT work-notes feature of BMC IT Service Management Suite versions 25.3.01, 25.4.01, and 26.1.01 allows authenticated users to execute stored scripts in other users' browsers.

item.title: CVE-2026-113688 · 5.3 MEDIUM — Server-Side Request Forgery in BMC ITSM SmartIT
